name: When is the best time to install kitchen task lighting during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to install kitchen task lighting during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time to install kitchen task lighting during a renovation is typically after framing, electrical rough-in, and before drywall installation. This allows our electricians to run wires easily within walls and behind cabinets without damaging finished surfaces. If you're only updating lighting in an existing kitchen, installation can be done at any time. However, integrating new lighting into a larger renovation ensures the most seamless and aesthetically pleasing result, as it minimizes patching and painting after installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: During a renovation, the best time to install task lighting is after electrical rough-in and before drywall, allowing for easy wiring and a seamless finish.
